tasks.label: commit
tasks.command: git add -A && MSG="$(gh copilot -- --allow-all-tools -p 'Generate a concise git commit message in Conventional Commits format (type(scope): description). Only output the commit message, nothing else. No quotes. No explanation.' 2>&1 | grep -E '^(feat|fix|chore|docs|style|refactor|test|build|ci|perf|revert)(\(.+\))?: .+' | head -1)" && echo "Commit message: $MSG" && git commit -m "$MSG"
